{{Quote|Imperial Knights&mdash;Defend your Emperor!|Antares Draco's command to the dark-haired Imperial Knight and several others|<ref name="Legacy 46" />}}
A [[Color/Legends|black]]-haired '''Human male''' was a member of the [[Imperial Knight]]s in [[137 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he and many other members of his order accompanied [[Roan Fel]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]], to [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] in order to conduct [[Mission to Agamar|peace talks]] with representatives of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. All those involved with the negotiations disguised themselves as [[Farm/Legends|farmers]], and several Imperial Knights, including the black-haired [[Gender/Legends|male]], pretended to work on a field nearby to the talks. Everyone shed their disguises, however, when a [[One Sith|Sith]] strike force arrived and [[Operation: Thunderstroke|attacked]]. The black-haired male fought in the ensuing skirmish, which ultimately saw the Emperor, as well as most of the Imperial Knights and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Biography==
In [[137 ABY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with [[Color/Legends|black]] hair was a member of the [[Imperial Knight]]s,<ref name="Legacy 46" /> an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] dedicated to the protection of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] and the preservation of [[Empire-in-exile|his Empire]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Fel traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] to conduct [[Mission to Agamar|peace talks]] with the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] in the hope of forging an alliance against the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] led by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]. The black-haired male was one of many Imperial Knights who served as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to Fel during the expedition. On the morning of the peace talks, everyone present disguised themselves as [[Agamarian]] [[Farm/Legends|farmers]]. While Fel and several Imperial Knight Masters spoke with four [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] representatives on Agamar's [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] plains, the black-haired male and a group of other Knights stood away from the talks, promoting their farmer deception by pretending to work on a nearby field.<ref name="Legacy 46" /><ref name="Legacy 45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref>

After Fel and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] negotiated a formal alliance between the two groups, the proceedings were interrupted by [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]]&mdash;the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] for Krayt's Empire&mdash;who was secretly aiding Fel. Riding a [[Agamarian beast|local animal]], she charged into the field where the black-haired male was stationed and dismounted when two Imperial Knights fired [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] at the beast. Calixte quickly told the assembled parties that Krayt's [[One Sith|Sith]] were aware of the meeting and had sent a [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce|task force]] to capture or [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Emperor.<ref name="Legacy 45" /> A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] strike team soon rose from some nearby swamps, and all farmer disguises were shed as a [[Operation: Thunderstroke|battle]] began. The black-haired male drew his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at a word from [[Antares Draco]],<ref name="Legacy 46" /> the leader of the Imperial Knights,<ref name="LECG" /> and every present Imperial Knight and Jedi fought off the attacking Sith in an effort to protect the Emperor. The ensuing combat saw at least ten Sith fall to Jedi and Imperial Knight blades, as well as to Calixte's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Legacy 46" /> Several Jedi and Imperial Knights were slain as well,<ref name="Legacy 48">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref> but Fel, K'Kruhk, and most of the survivors were able to evacuate the melee on the escape [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Defender One]]''.<ref name="Legacy 46" />

==Powers and abilities==
The black-haired male was a member of the Imperial Knights,<ref name="Legacy 46" /> an organization whose membership was exclusive to those who displayed potential in using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Imperial Knights were said to be among the most talented and dangerous Force-users in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Equipment==
He wore [[Imperial Knight armor]] and used the order's [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|standard lightsaber]]. On Agamar, the Imperial Knight donned farmer's robes.<ref name="Legacy 46" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The black-haired Imperial Knight was created by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]] for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', and first appeared in its [[Legacy (2006) 45|forty-fifth issue]],<ref name="Legacy 45" /> which was released on [[February 24]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54417/star_wars_legacy_2006_45|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #45}}</ref>
